concept: Taking care of your body with rest, water, and healthy food helps it work its best
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a character notices they feel better on days they rest, drink water, and eat well
exercise.reflection_prompt: What did the character notice was different on those days?
exercise.practice: Student names one way they take care of their body

assessment.success_marker: student names a real, specific self-care habit
